title: Biscoff Espresso Cloud Tiramisu
hookLine: Whipped mascarpone clouds layered with espresso-soaked biscuits & melted Biscoff drip.

items.name: Melted Biscoff cookie butter + cocoa dust

steps.title: Line Pan & Prep Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a loaf pan, baking dish, or serving glasses with parchment paper or chill them in the fridge for 5 minutes. Measure out {mascarpone}, {heavy_cream}, and {powdered_t} so your base whips up thick, creamy, and clump-free.

steps.title: Whip Cloud Cream to Soft Peaks
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip {mascarpone}, {heavy_cream}, and {powdered_t} together for 3 minutes until thick, pillowy peaks hold. Line your chilling pan or tray with parchment paper for easy lifting, and keep {mascarpone}, {heavy_cream}, and {powdered_t} measured and ready to combine.

steps.title: Dip Ladyfingers (1 Second Each)
steps.instructionTemplate: Dip {ladyfingers} briefly in {espresso} and line an 8x8 dish in an even layer. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.
steps.creatorSecret: Never soak ladyfingers longer than 1 second per side or the base turns soggy.

steps.title: Swirl Biscoff & Chill
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread half the mascarpone cream, drizzle warm {biscoff}, repeat layers, and dust generously with dark cocoa powder. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 6 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.criticalTip: Dust cocoa right before serving so it stays velvety dry.
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 15 mins.
